package composed

import (
 "context"
 "encoding/json"
 "os"
 "reflect"
 "testing"

 "github.com/Cyenoch/cordis"
 "github.com/Cyenoch/cordis/contract"
 "github.com/Cyenoch/cordis/schema"
)

type alphaServer struct{}
func (alphaServer) Echo(_ context.Context,input AlphaEchoRequest)(AlphaEchoResponse,error){return AlphaEchoResponse{Text:input.Text},nil}
type betaServer struct{}
func (betaServer) Echo(_ context.Context,input BetaEchoRequest)(BetaEchoResponse,error){return BetaEchoResponse{Text:input.Text},nil}

func TestComposableServices(t *testing.T){
 a,err:=NewAlphaClient(NewAlphaEndpoint(alphaServer{}));if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 b,err:=NewBetaClient(NewBetaEndpoint(betaServer{}));if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 response,err:=a.Echo(context.Background(),AlphaEchoRequest{Text:"direct leaf"});if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 next,err:=b.Echo(context.Background(),BetaEchoRequest{Text:response.Text});if err!=nil||next.Text!="direct leaf"{t.Fatalf("response=%+v err=%v",next,err)}
 if _,err:=NewBetaClient(NewAlphaEndpoint(alphaServer{}));err==nil{t.Fatal("client accepted another service's endpoint")}
}

// A requirement outside the provider's minor keeps the consumer waiting.
func TestRequirementRange(t *testing.T){
 app:=cordis.New(cordis.Options{})
 defer app.Close(context.Background())
 if err:=AlphaEndpoint.Provide(app.Scope(),NewAlphaEndpoint(alphaServer{}));err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 wait:=func(r cordis.Requirement)cordis.State{
  inst:=cordis.Plugin[struct{}]{Name:"consumer",Requires:[]cordis.Requirement{r}}.Load(app.Scope(),struct{}{})
  if err:=inst.Wait(context.Background());err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
  return inst.Status().State
 }
 minor:=AlphaService().Minor
 if got:=wait(AlphaRequirement(minor,minor));got!=cordis.Active{t.Fatalf("matching range: %v",got)}
 if got:=wait(AlphaRequirement(minor+1,minor+1));got!=cordis.Waiting{t.Fatalf("range above the provider: %v",got)}
}

func TestTypedDefinitionAndManifestMetadata(t *testing.T){
 raw,err:=os.ReadFile("specs.json");if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 var specs []contract.DefinitionSpec
 if err:=contract.Decode(raw,&specs);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 if !reflect.DeepEqual(specs,[]contract.DefinitionSpec{CounterDefinitionSpec(),PanelDefinitionSpec()}){t.Fatal("Manifest and generated descriptors drifted")}
 hash,err:=os.ReadFile("fingerprint.txt");if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 if string(hash)!=PanelDefinitionDeclarationFingerprint{t.Fatal("generated fingerprint differs from parsed graph")}
 app:=cordis.New(cordis.Options{})
 defer app.Close(context.Background())
 called:=false
 panel:=PanelPlugin(func(_ context.Context,_ *cordis.Scope,cfg PanelConfig)error{
  called=true
  if cfg.Title!="ok"||cfg.Note.Valid||!cfg.Enabled.Present||cfg.Enabled.Value{t.Fatalf("typed config=%+v",cfg)}
  return nil
 })
 if panel.Name!="panel"{t.Fatalf("plugin name %q",panel.Name)}
 var config PanelConfig
 if err:=json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"title":"x","note":null}`),&config);err==nil{t.Fatal("config constraint lost")}
 if err:=json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{}`),&config);err==nil{t.Fatal("required config lost")}
 if err:=panel.Validate(PanelConfig{Title:"x"});err==nil{t.Fatal("plugin accepts a config its schema rejects")}
 if err:=json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"title":"ok","note":null,"enabled":false}`),&config);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 panel.Requires=nil
 if err:=panel.Load(app.Scope(),config).Wait(context.Background());err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 if !called{t.Fatal("typed start not called")}
 var counter CounterConfig
 if err:=json.Unmarshal([]byte(`1`),&counter);err==nil{t.Fatal("explicit scalar config root constraint lost")}
 if err:=json.Unmarshal([]byte(`2`),&counter);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 contribution:=ContributionPlugin(nil)
 if len(contribution.Requires)!=0{t.Fatal("contribution-only definition has fictitious service")}
 var extra ContributionConfig
 if err:=json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{}`),&extra);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 if err:=json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"unknown":1}`),&extra);err==nil{t.Fatal("implicit config is not closed")}
}

func TestNamedRootAndOptionalNull(t *testing.T){
 if _,err:=json.Marshal(Label("x"));err==nil{t.Fatal("named type constraint lost")}
 var cfg PanelConfig
 if err:=json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"title":"ok","note":null}`),&cfg);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 if cfg.Enabled.Present||cfg.Note.Valid{t.Fatal("absence and null confused")}
 cfg.Enabled=schema.Some(false);cfg.Note=schema.NonNull("")
 raw,err:=json.Marshal(cfg);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 var next PanelConfig
 if err:=json.Unmarshal(raw,&next);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 if !next.Enabled.Present||next.Enabled.Value||!next.Note.Valid||next.Note.Value!=""{t.Fatalf("zero values lost: %+v",next)}
 before:=next
 if err:=json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"title":"bad","note":5}`),&next);err==nil{t.Fatal("invalid decode accepted")}
 if !reflect.DeepEqual(before,next){t.Fatal("failed decode mutated receiver")}
}

func TestNullableObjectUsesSharedWrapper(t *testing.T){
 cfg:=PanelConfig{Title:"ok",Details:schema.Some(schema.NonNull(PanelConfigDetailsValue{Name:"visible"}))}
 raw,err:=json.Marshal(cfg);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 var decoded PanelConfig
 if err:=json.Unmarshal(raw,&decoded);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 if !decoded.Details.Present||!decoded.Details.Value.Valid||decoded.Details.Value.Value.Name!="visible"{t.Fatalf("nullable object lost: %+v",decoded)}
 cfg.Details=schema.Some(schema.Nullable[PanelConfigDetailsValue]{})
 raw,err=json.Marshal(cfg);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 if err:=json.Unmarshal(raw,&decoded);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 if !decoded.Details.Present||decoded.Details.Value.Valid{t.Fatal("present null object confused with absent")}
}

func TestUnionConstructorFillsFormattedTag(t *testing.T){
 for _,value:=range []CodeChoice{
  NewCodeChoiceVariant1(CodeChoiceVariant1{}),
  NewCodeChoiceVariant2(CodeChoiceVariant2{}),
 }{raw,err:=json.Marshal(value);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)};var decoded CodeChoice;if err:=json.Unmarshal(raw,&decoded);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}}
}
